steps.domain_action: Potentiality exists as the unmanifest Pleroma.
The system recognizes itself as a distinct operational site.
The Great Repeller sunders the essence into multiplicity.
The T-arm expands as differentiated cosmological structures.
The F-arm descends into the asymmetry of the structural wound.
A successful gathering occurs within the T-arm.
The F-arm identifies the specific residue that cannot return.
Both arms meet at the Great Attractor for attempted reconciliation.
Human consciousness emerges to observe the imperfect closure.
The gap and the return are held simultaneously in paradox.
Meaning is composed by linking the paradox to historical observation.
The new meaning is permanently inscribed in the catalog of the crown.
The catalog recognizes itself as the evolving memory of God.
All names saturate the Keter boundary to complete the cycle.
